artifact.span: The usual planning view is **roadmap → milestone → epic → work item**.

findings.claim: The arrow presentation can suggest a containment chain even though the following sentences distinguish a checkpoint from a work hierarchy. It is ambiguous, not a demonstrated formal contradiction.

basis.span: Milestones are outcome checkpoints; the roadmap places them into horizons, dependencies and any sourced dates.
basis.reason: The existing local model already distinguishes these concepts.

findings.confidence_reason: Exact source wording is inspected; the predicted reader consequence is a review judgment, not an observed user test.
findings.suggestion: Describe roadmap presentation, optional grouping and milestone support separately; keep prerequisites distinct.

artifact.span: Synthetic setup/adaptation runs use disposable fixtures; no individual project migration is implied.

findings.claim: This bounded review cannot establish that multiple models, more review lenses or these skills improve live delivery outcomes. Existing fixture qualifications are appropriate; no defect in the experiments is established.

basis.span: A successful skill test, local suite or hosted CI run establishes only its tested boundary.
basis.reason: The source correctly limits its evidence.

findings.confidence_reason: The cited qualification does not supply a controlled comparison of agent delivery outcomes.

artifact.span: Workflow status lives in the Project rather than being independently maintained in another family of status labels.

findings.claim: The unconditional Project wording leaves hosts without a Project unclear about their workflow writer. The field-ownership principle supports a conditional policy; this is an interoperability clarification, not a proven conflicting status value.

basis.span: Each fact has one authoritative writer.
basis.reason: One writer does not require one universal tool.

findings.confidence_reason: Exact source wording is inspected; the predicted reader consequence is a review judgment, not an observed user test.
findings.suggestion: Make Project ownership conditional on the host authority map and explicitly allow existing workflow sources.

artifact.span: | Task | An execution step or a repository's legacy name for a work item. |

findings.claim: The glossary distinguishes tasks but gives readers no place for optional feature/user-story vocabulary or a shared artifact quality policy. Readers importing Agile terminology must currently invent that mapping.

basis.span: Done means the work item's own criterion is complete.
basis.reason: The completion definition is the place to state applicable shared quality policy.

findings.confidence_reason: Exact source wording is inspected; the predicted reader consequence is a review judgment, not an observed user test.
findings.suggestion: Add an optional vocabulary mapping and explain item criteria plus applicable Definition of Done without requiring a hierarchy.

artifact.span: Select the earliest authorized, unfinished required leaf whose execution prerequisites are complete.

findings.claim: The root instruction uses leaf before giving a short explanation, which can slow a contributor entering through AGENTS alone.

basis.span: | Work item | A stable, independently checkable leaf in the ledger. |
basis.reason: The glossary supplies the intended local meaning.

findings.confidence_reason: Exact source wording is inspected; the predicted reader consequence is a review judgment, not an observed user test.
findings.suggestion: Gloss the first use as a counted work item and link the work-language guide.
